full_update_rms_margin_rationale: The all-coordinate envelope is set to 1% because it must not be tighter than the already declared 1% repair-aligned scaling allowance. It was added after benchmark results were revealed and is not presented as prospectively frozen.
full_update_measurement: Exact Gram for vectors with at most 4096 coordinates; otherwise the maximum RMS ratio from three independently seeded, value-blind CountSketch summaries fixed before measurement.
profile_interval_scope: empirical variation across the frozen confirmation windows; not a random-state-population confidence guarantee

decision_rule.exact_identity: all confirmation update differences are exactly zero in a saved exact-vector representation; zero CountSketch summaries are not called bitwise identity
decision_rule.fixed_suite_update_equivalent: full update RMS is below 1% and all three profile intervals are strictly inside their declared margins
decision_rule.inconclusive: the full update RMS equals its boundary or a profile interval crosses its margin
decision_rule.abstain: the repair, state binding, parameter reach, or saved Gram is invalid

claim_boundary: This revision certifies update differences on the observed fixed input suite only. Large-vector certificates rely on three frozen randomized all-coordinate summaries rather than retained exact vectors. It does not certify a random training-state population, long-run loss, or complete training equivalence.
